environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (no IGW, no NAT for inbound). Traffic reaches the container exclusively through an internal ALB (scheme=internal). The ALB is fronted by AWS API Gateway (REST API, regional) configured with a usage plan and API key requirement. The API Gateway resource /api/users/search has a request validator enabled (validate query string parameters) with a defined model requiring 'username' to match regex pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$, 'department' to match ^[a-zA-Z ]{1,32}$, and 'role' to match ^[a-zA-Z]{1,16}$. The API Gateway method request has 'Request Validator' set to 'Validate query string parameters and headers'. Parameters failing the regex pattern cause a 400 response before reaching the ALB/container. Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway and the Fargate task's security group only allows inbound from the ALB's security group on port 8080.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, private subnet, no IGW
config.load_balancer: internal ALB, sg allows inbound only from API GW VPC link ENIs

api_gateway.request_validator: Validate query string parameters and headers

config.task_sg: inbound TCP 8080 from ALB SG only
